2026So Far: Chalk Week, and the Foreman Is Three Games ClearIn progress · 10 weeks in · dahlilama 17-3, Goldminers1 14-6, Birdgangflyeagles 13-7

Ten weeks in, every head-to-head winner also beat the median, so the jury split cleanly: six 2-0 weeks, six 0-2 weeks. dahlilama pulled three games clear, elysianbeer put up the top score, and Goldminers1 moved into second. The evidence so far.

A unanimous week

The Week 10 median landed at 116.31, and all six winners scored above it while all six losers scored below it. No lucky wins, no tough-luck losses. The line ran right between Bjspjs4 (118.24) and Sleon1000 (114.38), each 1.93 points away from it on opposite sides.

The foreman pulls away

dahlilama beat juleon8 128.72–75.80, a 52.92-point win and his fifth straight head-to-head victory. At 17-3 he's now three games ahead of the field, and he still leads the league in points (1,297, about 27 ahead of Goldminers1). He's the futures favorite at +150. juleon8's 75.80 was the week's low score, and he drops to 10-10.

elysianbeer's big afternoon

elysianbeer dropped 148.16, the top score of Week 10, and beat kevinnguu by 60.62, the biggest margin of the week. That's his third weekly high score of 2026, the most of anyone this season, and a 2-0 week that takes him from 10-8 to 12-8, fourth in the standings. kevinnguu has dropped two straight head-to-head and is 10-10.

Goldminers1 takes second

Goldminers1 beat Sleon1000 137.96–114.38, his third straight head-to-head win. At 14-6 he jumped past Birdgangflyeagles into second place, and he's second in points (1,269). Sleon1000's four-game head-to-head streak ended there, and he's 9-11, though the futures market still has him second at +750.

rbanuelos3 ends the skid

rbanuelos3 put up 138.46, the week's second-best score, and beat Birdgangflyeagles by 32.24. That snapped a five-game head-to-head losing streak and moved him to 8-12. The futures market likes it: he's third at +1,000. Birdgangflyeagles went 0-2 and slips to third at 13-7.

Also in the file

  • MayockJr beat showmeyourtd23 134.00–113.36, the closest game of the week at 20.64 points. He's won two straight head-to-head, is back to 10-10, and leads the league with 47 moves.
  • That makes a three-way tie at 10-10: kevinnguu, MayockJr and juleon8. juleon8 still has the fewest points against in the league (950).
  • Bjspjs4 beat giJ03 118.24–86.28 and is 9-11. No trades in Weeks 9 or 10, so he stays at seven for the year.
  • giJ03 has now lost six straight head-to-head, which puts him on the all-time Longest Losing Streak list. He's 4-16, level with showmeyourtd23 at the bottom.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 17-3, three games clear, and leads the league in points.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs. 9-11 after Week 10 ended a four-game head-to-head win streak.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 8-12 after a 138.46 snapped a five-game head-to-head skid.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 13-7 after an 0-2 Week 10 dropped him to third. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also second in the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.elysianbeer: Top score in Weeks 2, 4 and 10, the most weekly highs of 2026. 12-8 and fourth. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-16 with six straight head-to-head losses, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 9-11 with seven trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
